status: isolated candidate; not a production solenoid reconstruction

ford-pmgr-conventional-circuit.title: Ford US5475270A, Figure 1 conventional PM starter circuit
ford-pmgr-conventional-circuit.reviewed: Ford-assigned patent with 1993 priority. Background and Figure 1 describe the conventional separate battery/control supply, pull-in and holding coils, spring-biased normally open plunger contacts. This candidate uses that background only, not Figure 2's proposed single-terminal switching circuit. No production adoption or 1994 dimensions inferred.

ford-starter-solenoid-test.reviewed: Applicable factory test identifies S and M terminals and the frame as continuity-test nodes. It does not provide internal dimensions or contact geometry. Existing source registry entry retained.

geometry_assumptions.terminal_convention: Existing terminal-1 is B at x=-10; terminal-2 is M at x=10; new S at local x=0,y=-12. Clocking and shapes are model assumptions.
geometry_assumptions.return_spring: Four turns,0.25mm wire radius,5mm mean radius. Assumed compressed geometric clearance only, not force/preload validation.

integration.metadata: Update existing coil-envelope references and lessons only if candidate accepted. Default assembly remains static/open.

limits: Logical coil connections are specified but lead conductors, motor bus/brush feed and vehicle harness are absent; no physical electrical continuity claim.
Isolated solenoid stroke does not validate or drive lever, clevis, fork or pinion articulation.
No electromagnetic, thermal, arcing, insulation or loaded mechanical simulation.
